overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus S-Line 1 Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a personal wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for stress relief and improved circulation, this sauna features 7 strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, ensuring a soothing and energy-efficient experience. Constructed from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it includes a chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity for a truly immersive relaxation session. Ideal for indoor spaces like basements or fitness rooms, this sauna combines luxury and functionality with easy clasp-together assembly.
